t: This is James Allen's Girls' School, known as JAGS, a private day school in Dulwich. Founded in 1741, it's the second oldest girls' independent school in Great Britain, after the Godolphin School in Salisbury. The founder, James Allen, was a prominent eighteenth-century educationalist and Master of the College of God's Gift in Dulwich, and his name is still on the school today.
